## About
B.J. Trailer & Truck Repair is a trailer and truck shop on Chicago's southwest side, on S Monitor Ave. We handle trailer, container, chassis and reefer trailer repairs, along with heavy and light duty truck work.
Besides repairs, we buy, sell and lease dry vans, reefers, flatbeds, containers and chassis. Give us a call and ask for Andy or Damian, or stop by the shop.

## Services
- Trailer, container and chassis repair: Complete repairs on trailers, containers, chassis and reefer trailers, from door hinges to rollup door cables.
- Heavy and light duty truck repair: Repair and maintenance for heavy and light duty trucks, including tractors.
- Road recovery and on-site repairs: Mobile trucks for road recovery service and repairs done on site.
- Buy, sell and lease dry vans, flatbeds and containers: We buy, sell and lease dry vans, reefers, flatbeds, containers and chassis.

## FAQ
Q: Who should I ask for when I call?
A: Call the shop and ask for Andy or Damian.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're located on Chicago's southwest side.

Q: Can you come to my truck?
A: Yes. We have mobile trucks for road recovery service and on-site repairs.
